Name: Lynneas Witchy and Purple Tools and Scythes
Author: Lynneaura
Description:
[size=3]The last few days I worked on these sprites and now they are finally finished! I hope you like them!

For the color palette I referenced my recolor of Bog's Wizard Catalogue. <3 So it will fit with everything else :3

[b]Standard: [/b]some broken down tools with lilac metal

[b]Copper:[/b] pastel pink metal with vines

[b]Steel: [/b]dark teal metal, the dark wood has lilac swirls on it (just like the decorative tree from the wizard catalogue)

[b]Gold:[/b] pink/ruby metal with vines and flowers

[b]Iridium: [/b]purple metal with pink details and dark blue wood, added a "glow" around the tools and some stars/ sparkles[/size]
